title: The Founding Identity: How Chennai Super Kings Became More Than an IPL Entry
dek: Every franchise starts with a first season and a first squad. Chennai Super Kings' began in 2008; what that year looked like still shapes how they are seen.
excerpt: Chennai Super Kings played their first season in 2008, led by SK Raina with the bat and MS Gony with the ball. Some of that first squad stayed long enough to become the franchise's foundation.

sections.heading: More Than an Entry
body: A franchise becomes more than a team in a league when it builds continuity: players, a home ground and a recognisable way of playing that outlast a single season.

sections.heading: What the First Season Did Not Decide
body: First seasons are not destiny. Results, squads and owners change; the founding year is a starting point, not a prediction.
The later history of CSK is told season by season elsewhere in this series.

sections.heading: CricField Verdict: The Founders Who Stayed
body: Chennai Super Kings' founding identity rests on the players from 2008 who stayed. {{ev:fi-stayed}} of them played five or more seasons.
Those players are the bridge between the first squad and everything that followed.
